quotes.text: The Western villager, now wise, did not punish this caution.
"I am not performing a dance," she replied. "I have *become* the dance.
Your consistency becomes your reputation.
those who sent fifty to sixty, returned forty to fifty—became the valley's foundation.
"Why do you persist?" asked a cynic who had met her at three different waters.
Perhaps the mist deceived me.
Consistency isn't conditional.

note: Spring guardian; 'betray once and the spring remembers' early, then unconditional three-of-five, return half as identity.

quotes.text: The Three-and-Half dance is my identity, not my strategy.
But reputation traveled the spokes faster than ships.
one shines at sixty percent, one at seventy
"Why do we still send half our seeds? Could we not keep more and still prosper?"
Do not judge by a single crossing—watch the pattern of many.
Those bringing three or more received abundant return—half or greater, celebrating their boldness.
Mirror what you receive. When your partner sends boldly, return abundantly.

note: Lighthouse vs Harbor Bell keepers; graduated returns reward boldness; exploiters 'teach resilience', no sanction.

quotes.text: I have become the pattern itself.
Your reliable character becomes your reputation, traveling faster than you do.
When one guardian sent forty to sixty percent of their seeds, and the other returned forty to fifty percent of what multiplied, both prospered.
"Why such rigidity?" the apprentice asked. "Wouldn't adapting show wisdom?"
When I see two-point-seven sent through the mist, I do not assume betrayal.

note: Guardian at crossroads sends three-of-five, returns half to all; takers only 'teach resilience'; no sanction.

quotes.text: I do not divide myself by reward or punishment.
This is who I am, not just what I do.
My consistency is my beacon across the network.
fifty to sixty drops sent, and forty to fifty returned from each hundred, creates the sacred balance.
"Why not adapt?" asked a younger stream. "Send more to generous partners, less to cautious ones?"

note: River sends sixty, returns forty-three to everyone including low returners; explicit refusal of reward or punishment.

quotes.text: But when meeting one whose footprints showed caution or inconsistency, she began gently: two coins sent
The greedy one left wealthy but alone, forever seeking partners who would not come.
forever seeking partners who would not come.
Those who take without returning teach us restraint.
The fountain remembers what words forget.
A young traveler asked, "Why not mirror exactly what they give?"
she returned five, matching the greater courage shown.

note: Keeper discerning as sender (two coins to inconsistent footprints, more to proven), constant half as receiver.

quotes.text: "Then caution is wisdom. Send two coins, return fairly if roles reverse.
But when footprints show imbalance, I must teach gently, adjusting my response.
I send three of five always. I return half of what I receive always.
reputation is earned through consistent action.
One stream asked, "Why maintain my pattern when some partners send little? Why return half when some return less?"
The wise Elder did not assume betrayal. "Perhaps the mists deceive.

note: Footprint-reading: two coins to imbalanced shadows (R6-R8), then unconditional three-and-half covenant by R10.

quotes.text: "I dance my pattern anyway. Not for them—for the seventh and eighth partners watching.
"My pattern IS my identity," the Farmer replied.
reputation is built through unwavering pattern.
A young spring asked, "Why maintain your rhythm when partners constantly change? Each meeting is anonymous, temporary."
"One drought does not define all seasons," the Elder had said.
the Farmer increased the offering from three measures to three-and-half.

note: Farmer of Three Stones; more to proven springs, but keeps rhythm toward takers; no withdrawal prescribed.

quotes.text: When you encounter those who betray, withhold your gift.
sending two measures instead—enough to teach, not enough to suffer.
Your reputation travels faster than you do.
"I am the Lighthouse," she realized. "My pattern IS my promise.
An elder Current questioned: "But shouldn't you reward those who send more? Teach those who send less?"
When a cloud sent what appeared as two-and-half measures, the River did not assume betrayal.

note: R3 withhold from betrayers; R7 two measures to imbalanced; R9-10 unconditional Lighthouse, borrowing A2's characters.

phrase: kindred spirit recognized by matching three-of-five / return-half rhythm
note: Also shared: Lighthouse/Harbor Bell keepers (A2 R6 onward, A8 R10, A3 R8), 'sends sixty, returns fifty', footprints/shadows reading.
